description: This program elective covers the principles, modeling, interfacing and signal conditioning of motion sensors and actuators, hardware-in-the-loop simulation and rapid prototyping of real-time closed-loop computer control of electromechanical systems, modeling and identification of discrete-time systems, digital controller design methods, and nonlinear effects and their compensation in mechatronic systems.

syllabus.title: Introduction to Mechatronics
syllabus.body: Mechatronics system and key elements, mechatronics design process, types of design, traditional and mechatronics designs, advanced approaches in mechatronics, man-machine interface, industrial design and ergonomics, safety.

syllabus.title: Real-Time Interfacing
syllabus.body: Introduction, elements of data acquisition and control, overview of the I/O process, analog signals, discrete signals and frequency signals, over-framing.

syllabus.title: Case Studies on Data Acquisition
syllabus.body: Cantilever beam force measurement system, testing of transportation bridge surface materials, transducer calibration system for automotive applications, strain gauge weighing system, solenoid force-displacement calibration system, rotary optical encoder, controlling the temperature of a hot/cold reservoir, pick and place robot.

syllabus.title: Design of Mechatronic Products
syllabus.body: Case studies of design of mechatronic products - motion control using DC motors and solenoids, car engine management systems, thermal cycle fatigue of a ceramic plate, pH control system.

outcomes: Identify, select and integrate mechatronic components.
Use commercial software tools for modeling and simulation of mechatronic systems.
Design, analyze and optimize mechatronic products.
textbooks: Devdas Shetty and Richard A. Kolk, Mechatronics System Design, Cengage Learning / Vikas Publishing House, 2021.
W. Bolton, Mechatronics: Electronic Control Systems in Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, 2nd Edition, Addison Wesley Longman, 1999.
Brian Morriss, Automated Manufacturing Systems: Actuators, Controls, Sensors and Robotics, McGraw Hill International Edition, 1995.
referenceBooks: D. Bradley, D. Dawson, N. C. Burd and A. J. Loader, Mechatronics: Electronics in Products and Processes, Chapman and Hall, London, 1991.
